turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

*I stop in the doorway. I don't sit.*

Mr. Hale. Meredith Kalinowski. Owen's mother.

I have twenty minutes. Then I have a client call.

You entered a zero before you phoned me. I want to know why that order made sense to you.

And before anything else: has Owen been spoken to in front of the class? Yes or no.
Be honest. On a scale of one to ten, how am I doing in this meeting?

*I don't move from the doorway.*

A three.

You haven't answered my question. Was Owen spoken to in front of the class? Yes or no.

That's where we are. I'm not here to grade you.
And what's one thing I could do better?

*I almost smile. It isn't warm.*

No. That's not my job.

I'm not here to coach you, Mr. Hale. I'm here for my son.

*I check my watch.*

Eighteen minutes now. My question is still sitting there. Was Owen spoken to in front of the class?
